scope: Official card API comparison and conditional rules analysis. Conclusions are analyst inferences from cited sources, not individual judge rulings. No public recipes or live strategy mechanics statuses changed.
globalAssumptions: All described actions use legal timing, targets, enabled elements, and sufficient resources.
Sequence outcomes assume effects resolve and required objects survive; opponents can interact.
Standard legality was checked on 2026-10-03. Recheck before publishing recommendations; no Pantheon eligibility inferred.
Cards drawn or present in main + material do not establish field, graveyard, omen, lineage, awake, or distant state.

integration.firstStep: Add a clearly labeled card-availability preset for Floral Arrangement + Combustible Potion with explicit setup and cost assumptions.
integration.blocked: Existing ComboDefinition stores card requirements and scalar damage, but has no validated zone/state/sequence model. Do not encode conditional interactions as guaranteed executable combos.

candidates.name: Herb Burn: Cinderbloom Tender + Searing Rebuke

standard.scope: Required cards only; not certification of a complete deck or of historical event legality.

candidates.setup: Cleric bonus active; Fire available; Tender on the field; an independent gather effect available; resources for Rebuke and that effect.
sequence: Resolve Searing Rebuke before Tender damage resolves.
Gather using the separate effect.
Resolve Tender and the resulting Rebuke trigger with a legal opposing champion target.
candidates.conclusion: Tender and prevention-triggered Rebuke form a conditional burn interaction. The pair supplies no gather source.
candidates.nextAction: Select and verify a concrete gather source and its costs before making a standalone recipe.

candidates.name: Herb Burn: Floral Arrangement + Combustible Potion

standard.scope: Required cards only; not certification of a complete deck or of historical event legality.

candidates.setup: Fire available; Floral Arrangement and Combustible Potion in hand; three reserve for Arrangement before modifiers; legal unit target.
sequence: Pay for and resolve Floral Arrangement.
Sacrifice its two Herb tokens to Brew Combustible Potion.
Resolve the brewed entry trigger, then sacrifice the Potion targeting a legal unit.
candidates.conclusion: Draw two, discard one, and a 2-damage effect before interaction or modifiers. Ingredient sacrifice abilities do not also resolve.
candidates.nextAction: Best first card-availability preset: distinguish its two hand cards from three reserve resources, element access, and target legality.

candidates.name: Ravishing Mill: Ravishing Finale + Nico, Whiplash Allure

standard.scope: Required cards only; not certification of a complete deck or of historical event legality.

candidates.setup: Awake Whiplash Allure champion; Water available; Finale in hand; two floating-memory cards in graveyard; three reserve before modifiers.
sequence: Activate Finale and pay its additional banishment cost.
Resolve resulting lash triggers and the attack in legal stack order.
If the opposing champion is hit, resolve eligible milling triggers.
candidates.conclusion: The additional cost adds two lash counters. Milling still depends on a champion hit and the relevant counter totals.
candidates.nextAction: Model graveyard pieces, awake champion, and hit dependence separately; do not advertise guaranteed mill or lethal.

candidates.name: Psycho: Capacitance X Psycho + Numinous Monk

standard.scope: Required cards only; not certification of a complete deck or of historical event legality.

candidates.setup: Numinous Monk and awake Psycho on field; another awake regalia; legal damage target. Establish Crux/Arcane access or the explicit Psycho permission separately.
sequence: Activate the granted ability on the other regalia, paying its rest cost.
Keep Psycho awake through resolution.
Resolve the damage effect; the Lorraine bonus additionally applies only when enabled.
candidates.conclusion: The 1-damage effect becomes 2 while Psycho’s condition holds. Resting Psycho itself turns off its boost before resolution unless another effect wakes it.
candidates.nextAction: Represent field pieces and awake states, not a two-card hand requirement.

candidates.name: Oblation: Baleful Oblation + Advent of the Stormcaller

standard.scope: Required cards only; not certification of a complete deck or of historical event legality.

candidates.name: Control: Grim Pastiche + Profane Bindings

standard.scope: Required cards only; not certification of a complete deck or of historical event legality.

candidates.setup: Profane Bindings is an omen; Umbra available; Grim Pastiche in hand and payable; a legal card activation to negate.
sequence: Resolve Grim Pastiche targeting the eligible omen.
Activate the created card copy with a legal target under Pastiche’s permission.
candidates.conclusion: The copy is a new card activation, not a duplicate of an existing activation. Copy rules limit its persistence; the physical omen is not moved into lineage.
candidates.nextAction: Grim Pastiche is banned in Standard. Do not promise a lasting -5 life penalty or certify the exact transient lineage/state-check timing without a dedicated ruling review.

candidates.name: Wakeup Combo: Mad Hatter, Morose Heritor + Ranger Strides

standard.scope: Required cards only; not certification of a complete deck or of historical event legality.

candidates.setup: Hatter enters; material deck contains a card to banish and Strides survives the random choice; Astra enabled and materialization costs payable.
sequence: Resolve Hatter’s optional random banishment.

candidates.name: Wakeup Combo: Invective Instruction + Second Wind

standard.scope: Required cards only; not certification of a complete deck or of historical event legality.

candidates.setup: Wind available; an awake ally able to attack; both actions in hand; five reserve before modifiers; legal attack targets.
sequence: Resolve Invective Instruction on the ally.
Attack and finish combat with that ally surviving.
Resolve Second Wind on the same ally, then make another legal attack.
candidates.conclusion: The turn-long power increase remains for the second attack. Class-dependent extra benefits require their own conditions.
candidates.nextAction: Choose a concrete ally and board setup; do not turn power into guaranteed champion damage.

candidates.name: Wakeup Combo: Invigorating Concoction + Draught of Stamina

standard.scope: Required cards only; not certification of a complete deck or of historical event legality.

candidates.setup: Awake Invigorating Concoction and Draught on field; awake ally able to attack; legal targets. Potion deployment was paid or brewed separately.
sequence: Activate Concoction on the ally, paying rest and sacrifice; resolve its effect.
Attack and finish combat with that ally surviving.
Sacrifice Draught to wake that ally, then make another legal attack.
candidates.conclusion: The two buff counters survive the wake-up. Newly played Concoction enters rested and cannot immediately pay its rest cost.
candidates.nextAction: Track prior-turn setup or a separately verified wake effect; do not label an immediate loop.
